heroLead: Hillman is small farm-country town in eastern Montmorency County, and the mineral interests tied to land out here have the same real Antrim Shale story as the rest of the county, just fewer people asking about it.
intro: Hillman sits in eastern Montmorency County, agricultural land that saw Antrim Shale leasing and drilling during the boom years of the late 1980s and 1990s. Mineral ownership around Hillman commonly traces through longtime farm families, with interests split among heirs over the decades as the original owners passed the land, and sometimes just the minerals, down through the generations.

sections.heading: What we find when we look at Hillman-area title
paragraphs: It's common in this part of the county for mineral rights to have been separated from the surface generations back, sometimes through a straightforward sale, sometimes through inheritance that split one original interest into several small pieces held by cousins who've never compared notes. The Montmorency County register of deeds in Atlanta holds the recorded chain if you're trying to sort out exactly what your family holds.

sections.heading: The honest number on a Hillman-area interest
paragraphs: Wells tied to this part of the county are, by now, decades into a long, flat decline, producing modest, steady volumes rather than anything close to their 1990s peak. We price interests here off current statements and activity, and we'll tell you plainly if a modest number is the honest one.

sections.heading: What we need to evaluate a Hillman-area interest
paragraphs: Send your deed or probate document, any royalty statements or division orders you've received, and the legal description if you have it. If your family's interest passed through several generations without formal division, tell us what you know and we'll help fill in the gaps.
We'll check the recorded chain of title and current production for your section before saying anything about what the interest is worth.

faqs.question: Is Hillman part of the Antrim Shale core?
faqs.answer: Yes, Hillman sits in Montmorency County, one of the historic core counties of the Antrim trend, and the surrounding farmland saw drilling activity during the 1980s and 1990s boom.

faqs.question: How do I find out what mineral interest my family holds near Hillman?
faqs.answer: Start with the Montmorency County register of deeds in Atlanta and pull the deed or probate record showing the transfer of the interest to your family.

faqs.question: Why is my royalty check from a Hillman-area well so small now?
faqs.answer: Antrim wells in this county are decades past their early production peak and now sit on the long, flat tail typical of a mature biogenic gas well, which means smaller volumes and smaller checks.

faqs.question: Can several heirs each sell their own share of a Hillman-area mineral interest separately?
faqs.answer: Yes, generally each heir can sell their individual fractional share independently, though clean deed or probate documentation showing how the interest was divided makes the process faster.
